text: Ko wano Men Jarribor maa nii ɓee ayɓe sirkooɓe, Men Jarribornoo kala Annabaajo ado maa : Men Waɗani gooto kala e maɓɓe ayɓe yimɓe murtuɓe e ayɓe jinna murtuɗi ; yoga maɓɓe no sowonsina yoga, ɓe cuɗindirana hodo. Sinno Alla Muuyuno, ɓe waɗataano ɗum, O Muuyu tun fii jarribagol ɓe, tertodu ɓe e ko ɓe fenindotoo meere e keeferaaku, wata a haaje e ɗum.
